svg.title: Concentration: Stained glass
svg.desc: Concentration (1D): a memory match laid out as a stained-glass window of twelve cards. Two cards just turned show the same healer's face and are lighting up as a pair; two pairs are already kept; one card has blanked to clear glass and can only be matched from memory. On the right the kept faces line up, the flips left are counted, and a glass candle burns down to the next blanking.
